scope: Auditable P.1100/P.1110/P.1120 acoustic qualification orchestration. A catalog entry is a requirement to collect evidence, not a measured result.

NB.formal_text_gate: Operator must supply a verified edition/body artifact and reconcile every customer-workbook limit to the current clause.

WB.formal_text_gate: Operator must supply a verified edition/body artifact and reconcile every customer-workbook limit to the current clause.

SWB.formal_text_gate: Local P.1120 PDF and extracted text have immutable SHA-256 identity; NV200 workbook rows remain explicitly customer limits.

FB.formal_text_gate: FB has no workbook-derived rows in the supplied NV200 sheet; use the official P.1120 FB clauses and masks.

topology.label: DUT vehicle / calibrated cabin
requirements: Production-like microphone, speaker, housing and acoustic-zone placement
Reference marks for repeatable HATS and microphone positions
Vehicle HVAC and all relevant systems energized

topology.label: P.58 HATS with P.57 ears
requirements: Driver/acoustic-zone position with MRP and DRP exposed
Binaural receive capture and P.581 diffuse-field processing

topology.label: Synchronized cabin noise reproduction
requirements: C1-C5 driving recordings from the target vehicle and installation
Four-loudspeaker system plus subwoofer, or a compliant spatial reproduction system
A-weighted reproduction within 1 dB and third-octave spectrum within 3 dB

topology.label: DUT, POI and system simulator
requirements: Exact firmware, volume setting, codec/network path and SRW variant
Calibrated electrical reference points POI SEND and POI RECEIVE
Physical and timestamped send/receive loopback for delay

topology.label: Signals, approved methods and measurement analysis
requirements: Current P.501 signal pack and exact content identity
Approved P.863/POLQA build and ETSI TS 103 281 method package where applicable
Working level, pass/fail limits and independent results source retained by the test house

topology.label: Immutable evidence and review
requirements: Every standard gate has a hashed source artifact
Raw captures/instrument traces retained for every reported measurement
Independent reviewer attests scope, calculations, masking and conclusions

formal_completion_rule: A customer-workbook row can pass only against its recorded customer limit. It cannot establish official standard compliance. Formal completion requires current standard evidence, all calibrated physical captures, approved external method identities, and independent review.
